summary: Officers were sent to the 2,700 block of Ming Avenue for a robbery that had just happened at a clothing store, where a man in a ski mask took merchandise and left eastbound in a white sedan.
Deputies were sent to the 8,400 block of Panama Road for a report of a man with a kitchen knife; he was reported to be inside the residence and no longer holding the knife.
Fire crews were sent to a structure fire on Ledgeview Lane.

Officers were sent to the 2,400 block of Calloway Drive after a caller reported his wife was in crisis and had talked about harming their 7-month-old child; she was reported to have no firearm in the home.
Officers were sent to South Chester Avenue and Ming Avenue after a passerby reported a hit and run involving a dark minivan; the person struck was last seen at the bus stop.
Deputies and medics were sent to the 400 block of Hayslett Avenue, where crews found a man who had been assaulted and asked for police and a second ambulance.

Officers were sent into the 10th Street area for a domestic argument where the other person in the home was reported to have a firearm, and a roommate was reported to have threatened to shoot the caller.
Fire crews were sent to a structure fire on North Alberta Street, with three engines and a battalion chief assigned.
Deputies were told of a possible drunken driver north of Lost Hills, a Nissan sedan reported to be running at speeds near 100 mph.
Fire crews were sent to a structure fire on Campus Park Court, with two engines and a truck assigned.
Deputies were sent to the 6,500 block of Niles Street for a welfare check on a 7-year-old reported to be outside alone.
Deputies were sent to the 500 block of Shady Meadow for a domestic disturbance that had just happened; the man left westbound in a blue semi truck and the person who called declined medical aid.
Officers were sent to a school on the 600 block of B Street for a welfare check on a student who was reported to be in distress.
Fire crews and medics were sent to Sterling Road and Monterey Street for a vehicle against a pedestrian, with CPR under way.
Officers were sent to the 200 block of Warren Avenue after a caller reported a break-in and disconnected.
Fire crews were sent to a car fire on a Honda whose owner told dispatchers he believed it was arson and wanted to file a report; the fire was about 20 feet by 20 feet and one patrol unit handled it.
Officers were sent to the 3,200 block of F Street for a verbal argument between neighbors.
Deputies were told of a possible drunken driver heading north on Asher Avenue from Pico Street in the South Taft area, with the driver reported to have been drinking at a food stand.
Medics and the highway patrol were sent to Schofield Drive and Wilson Avenue for a person down, with a request for discretion.
Fire crews were sent to a structure fire at an apartment on the 2,200 block of Nelson Street.

A large response was sent to the railroad northeast of Woodford, near Tehachapi, after agents investigating a burglary of a train container reported that people inside the container shot at them. Two agents were reported not to be hurt, the agents took cover behind their vehicles, and one suspect was later believed to have run south and then southwest, with no description. Access was worked out from the Highway 58 side and off Woodford and Keene, and the railroad was cleared to resume traffic about 4 a.m.
Deputies were sent to the 400 block of Buchanan for a disturbance where someone was reported to be yelling.

Deputies chased a vehicle northbound on Airport Drive from Lincoln Street, at speeds reported from 35 to 67 mph past Woodrow and Ann Arbor; the pursuit was called off in the area northwest of the airport.
Fire crews and medics were sent to a single vehicle that rolled over into a house, with two people hurt; the ambulance request was increased to two units.
Deputies were told a stolen blue Yamaha motorcycle was last tracked to the 300 block of Wilson Avenue, where the person was reported to be circulating.
Deputies were sent to a motel for an occupied stolen vehicle, with a black Cadillac Escalade involved.
Deputies were sent to a business on the 6,300 block of White Lane after the back door was found open, with someone in a black long sleeve shirt and dark blue pants pushing a shopping cart.
Officers were sent to the 4,900 block of South Union Avenue on a call transferred from the county on an incomplete 911.
Officers were sent to the 4,200 block of Chester Avenue for a hold-up alarm at a residence, third point of activation.

Deputies and fire crews were sent to South Mount Vernon Avenue and East Belle Terrace for a possible drowning after a caller said someone had fallen at a water pipe, then said his brother had been thrown into a cement water tank and could be heard inside. Crews searched south along Mount Vernon and the caller then reported he was climbing the water tower himself.
Fire crews were sent to an outside fire on the 400 block of 4th Avenue.
Fire crews were sent to a fire reported about two feet from a building.
An engine was sent to a dumpster fire at an RV park.
Officers and medics were sent to the 900 block of Olive Drive for a welfare check and a 2-year-old reported not to be breathing; crews found the child breathing and attached to breathing equipment.
Fire crews were sent to a vehicle in a ditch just east of East Panama Lane and South Fairfax Road, with the vehicle reported to be smoking, and the highway patrol was en route.
Deputies were sent to the 6,200 block of Derby Drive for a domestic disturbance that had just happened.
The highway patrol was told of a wrong-way driver on the transition from southbound Interstate 5 to eastbound Highway 138, a sedan reported northbound in the southbound lane.
The highway patrol was told of a hit and run on northbound Highway 99, a red Toyota sedan with front end damage; the person who was hit was standing by on the right shoulder.
Officers took about four calls reporting shots heard in the area of Morrill Avenue and Airport Drive.
Crash at White Lane and South Union with injuries.
Two vehicles in collision on Calloway Drive.
Suspicious vehicle found off I-5 roadway.
Multiple disturbance calls near North Chester.
Loitering complaint near bus stop and market.
Hit-and-run crash on Highway 99 near Bullion.
Officers attempt stop of white GMC Terrain.
Person threatened to shoot self near White Lane.
